messages:
hannah: opened a small docs PR that adds a migration note + example for mapping traces to console cost panels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1310
diego: nice. does it include the quickstart snippets for both python and node?
hannah: yep — short examples for both. used placeholder numbers and added a clear callout: "example values only".
mina: FYI the Node snippet used `traceKey` in one spot; changed to `trace_key` to match current SDK. pushed fix.
hannah: thanks. i also added a tiny troubleshooting section: rendering large flamegraphs can time out in image pipeline; suggested workaround is export at 50% and include click-to-zoom.
doc-bot: RenderJob #478 timed out previously. Suggest splitting the flamegraph into two tiles or reduce DPI when exporting from VizTool.
diego: can we replace the big flamegraph with an interactive embed iframe? some browsers block cross-origin iframes in our docs site. maybe not worth the risk.
mina: added alt text, aria-labels, and a one-line UX note about keyboard focus for the trace jump link. pushed.
hannah: i added a short example query showing how to fetch cost by span group: ```sql
SELECT span_group, SUM(cost) FROM metrics WHERE project='demo' GROUP BY span_group
```
diego: small nit: call out that if your telemetry uses `svc` tag instead of `service.name` to update the WHERE clause accordingly.
hannah: added that. also included a mapping table for legacy tile ids -> new trace_key values for folks migrating dashboards.
mina: LGTM from my side. once CI passes, can we ask UX to glance at the composite image? they flagged color contrast last time.
diego: pinged ux-accessibility. asked for a 2hr turnaround. :hourglass: 
hannah: thanks. i'll hold merge until their quick review or until CI flips green. merging after that and tagging docs:console in the changelog.
mina: note to reviewers: do not copy example cost numbers into customer docs; run the live metric query instead.
doc-bot: LinkCheckJob #923: broken anchor '/console/costs#span-group' detected. Recommended update to '/console/observability#span-groups'.
hannah: fixed anchor in the PR. re-running CI.
